messages.subject: Project Harbor - ARA: Pennine mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Pennine's mark-up of the amendment and restatement agreement is attached. Headline changes from our side: margin uplift to 1.50% (so 5.00% all-in on the senior), super-senior margin to 10.00%, and the Tranche B EBITDA milestone to £2.25m. We've also tightened the equity cure to three uses over the life. Credit see these as the price of the new money.

Let's get a call in the diary.

Alistair Whitlock | Partner | Pemberton Rowe LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - ARA: our response
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Our turn attached. We can move on margin but not all the way - 1.375% uplift (4.875% all-in) and super-senior at 9.75%. The client will not go above £2.1m on the Tranche B milestone (December is seasonally strong and they need the certainty), and the cure right needs to stay at four uses. If Pennine can live with that we have a deal.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
